description:
Activate Weaver of Currents by tapping it, adding {C}{C}
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Weaver of Currents.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Weaver of Currents.
Repeat.
